rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs in req.md are traced by S-1 to S-4; there are no assumed or unknown REQs.
S-1 to S-3 each hold one outcome. S-4 still bundles two outcomes: the page/slot list is unchanged, and no private data is shown (previous F-3).

Previous F-1 is fixed: S-3 AC4/AC5 now cover the started-slot and no-availability partitions. ACs are Given/When/Then and discriminating (lakh grouping, stale fee). S-4 AC3 is still broad (previous F-2).
Fee values come from REQ-2/REQ-5 or are derived inline (divided by 100, Indian grouping) from the glossary Paise entry.
Terms are clear and consistent (paise, Consultation fee, Scheduled, free slot) and match the intent and glossary.

findings.text: Previous F-2 still open: S-4 AC3 checks that 'every other field, label and button' works as before but names none of them, so it is hard to check precisely.

cites.quote: every other field, label and button is present and works as before this change

findings.suggested_fix: Name the page's existing fields (Patient, Doctor, date, slot, reason, Book) in the AC.

findings.text: Previous F-3 still open: S-4 bundles two outcomes. One is that the slot list and page are unchanged (REQ-8, REQ-12). The other is that no private data is shown (REQ-13, REQ-14).

cites.quote: The rest of the page stays as it was and shows no private data

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-4 into a page-unchanged story and a no-private-data story.

findings.text: S-3 AC5 covers only a weekday with no availability at all. No AC checks a time outside the availability block's start/end on a weekday the doctor does work.

cites.quote: Given a date on a weekday when the chosen doctor has no availability
weekday, start time, end time, in hospital local time

findings.suggested_fix: Add or extend an AC so that no slot is offered outside the block's start and end times on a working weekday.

the page shows no fee and staff can still book
in the future and not overlapping a Scheduled appointment
